station_name: Cascade Canal near Fish Lake, Oreg.
township_range_section: SE¼ sec. 30, T. 36 S., R. 5 E.
notes: Sampled table = daily discharge grid only (the monthly summary below is table 2). Printed values: May 28-31 = 4, June 1-30 = 30, July 1-31 = 31; total 65. Dashes (May 1-27, June 31) and the empty October-April, August and September columns not counted; the note 'No flow during August and September' prints no daily values. Dates = water year in the title, although values are printed only for May 28 to July 31, 1935. Canal diverts water from Fourmile Creek, so Irrigation. Other location words: at divide between Rogue River and Klamath River Basins, 3 miles above Fish Lake; gaging station is 10 miles below point of diversion. No station number or county printed.
